game_title: Not Negator – Net Menders' Pier Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the deckhand slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the deckhand slips through safely. Each round, pirate raiders strike the harbor gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stealth value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier: keep the stealth meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: stealth drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 33 seconds while stealth > 0.
